Bassist and trombonist Chris Brubeck, and drummer Dan Brubeck keep their parents’ legacy alive by touring with the Brubeck Brothers Quartet. They also lead their own ensembles, performing music that encompasses an eclectic mix of contemporary styles.
Chris and Dan were interviewed in Clinton, New York on February 19, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
